answer: Every grader stakes credit at its vertex in a trust graph and is paid by peer-prediction scoring: each report earns rewards for predicting what the rest of the panel independently concludes. A sybil buying fake identities must still grade, and lazy or collusive answers cluster into a mesa of correlated wrong votes that the scoring detects and punishes, pushing those clones off the profitability ledge. Attack cost becomes continuously burned stake, far exceeding honest grading income.
